docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Bloomfield’s translation of Bhāvadevasūri’s Pārśvanātha-caritra, the life of the twenty-third Tīrthaṅkara, with its fables and stories from the Jaina tradition (Baltimore, 1919). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Library of Congress; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The life and stories of the Jaina savior, Parçvanatha · Bhavadevasuri, Bloomfield, Maurice, 1855-1928, ed · 1919, 282 scanned pages. Published 1919; Maurice Bloomfield died 1928; the text is medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
